name: FLECT Co.,Ltd.
summary: FLECT Co., Ltd., headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, and formed in 2005, provides multi-cloud integration solutions for digital transformation. Its DX support covers strategic planning, UI and UX design, cloud-based development and operational oversight, built by combining public cloud services. It also offers Cariot Service, a cloud platform that links vehicles directly with corporate operations to modernize driver work styles.
